code from https://www.i-deel.org/blog/around-meta-analysis-13-deduplicating-bibliographic-records

R v 4.2.2



```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse) # version 2.0.0
library(synthesisr) # version 0.3.0
library(revtools) # version 0.4.1


```

```{r}
# read data 
raw <- read.csv("../search_2025-01-17/Ryyan_cobined_biblilist.csv") #load the file
decided <- read.csv("../screening/Decisions_2025-02-05.csv")

# format (recover the authors, clean up the decisions etc)
dec = merge(decided, raw, by="title", all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE) %>%
  distinct(key.x, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(title, key.x, year.y, journal.y, issn.y, volume.y, issue.y, pages.y, authors.y, url.y, publisher.y, abstract.y, doi.y, notes.x) %>%
  rename(RayanID = key.x, year = year.y, journal = journal.y, issn = issn.y, volume = volume.y, issue = issue.y, pages = pages.y, authors = authors.y, url = url.y, publisher = publisher.y, abstract =  abstract.y, doi = doi.y, notes = notes.x) %>%
  mutate(included = str_detect(notes, "Included")) %>%
  mutate(Title_Screening_Lena = str_detect(notes, "Léna")) %>%
  mutate(Title_Screening_Alberto = str_detect(notes, "Alberto")) %>%
  mutate(Nobs_title_screening = Title_Screening_Lena+Title_Screening_Alberto)

# remove all excluded papers
included = dec %>% filter(included == TRUE) %>% 
  select(!starts_with("Title_Screening")) %>%
  select(!notes)

# select 50% of papers that should be read by two authors
npapers = length(included$title)
indices = 1:npapers
overlap = sample(indices,0.5*npapers, replace = FALSE)

# of the 50% that will not be read by two observers, select 50% (= 25% of the total) for each observer
nonoverlap = indices[-overlap]
lena = sample(nonoverlap, 0.5*length(nonoverlap), replace = FALSE)
alberto = nonoverlap[-which(nonoverlap %in% lena)]

# sampling into table
included$Lena_must_read = 0
included$Alberto_must_read = 0
included$Lena_must_read [c(overlap, lena)] = 1
included$Alberto_must_read[c(overlap, alberto)] = 1

write.csv(included, "../screening/Included_papers_to_screen_2025-02-05.csv" , row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
# read data 
raw <- read.csv("../search_2025-01-17/Ryyan_cobined_biblilist.csv") #load the file
dec <- read.csv("../screening/Decisions_2025-02-05.csv")
supl = read.csv("../screening/SordelloEtal_suppl.csv")

supl = supl %>% filter(population_vertebrates.birds=="yes") %>%
  mutate(test = ifelse(outcome_biophys=="yes"|outcome_repro=="yes",1,0)) %>%
  filter(test==1) %>%
  mutate(title2 = stringr::str_replace_all(biblio_title,"[:punct:]","") %>% str_replace_all(.,"[ ]+", "") %>% tolower())

snb = read_ref("../screening/backwardsSnowballmetassince2018_2025-02-06.ris") %>%
  mutate(title2 = stringr::str_replace_all(title,"[:punct:]","") %>% str_replace_all(.,"[ ]+", "") %>% tolower())



decided = dec %>%  mutate(title2 = stringr::str_replace_all(title,"[:punct:]","") %>% str_replace_all(.,"[ ]+", "") %>% tolower()) 

for (i in 1:length(decided$title)){
  decided$authors[i] = raw$authors[which(raw$title==decided$title[i])[1]]
}
  
tsac = data.frame(title2 = c(decided$title2, supl$title2, snb$title2), 
                 dtset = c(rep("decided", times = length(decided$title2)), 
                           rep("supl", times = length(supl$title2)),
                           rep("snowball", times = length(snb$title2))))

dat2 <- distinct(tsac, title2, .keep_all = TRUE) #reduce to records with unique titles (removes exact duplicates)
 
dim(dat2) #see the new number of records
#View(arrange(dat2, title2)$title2) #an optional visual check - sorted titles

duplicates_string <- synthesisr::find_duplicates(dat2$title2, method = "string_osa", to_lower = TRUE, rm_punctuation = TRUE, threshold = 7)
dat3 = synthesisr::extract_unique_references(dat2, duplicates_string, type="select")

end = merge(decided, dat3, by = "title2", all= TRUE)

for (i in 1:length(end$title2)){
  if(is.na(end$dtset[i])){
    end$dtset[i] = "dupli"
  }else if(end$dtset[i] == "snowball"){
    end$title[i] = snb$title[which(snb$title2 == end$title2[i])]
    end$year[i] = snb$year[which(snb$title2 == end$title2[i])]
    end$author[i] = snb$author[which(snb$title2 == end$title2[i])]
    end$journal[i] = snb$journal[which(snb$title2 == end$title2[i])]
    end$doi[i] = snb$doi[which(snb$title2 == end$title2[i])]
    end$volume[i] = snb$volume[which(snb$title2 == end$title2[i])]
    end$abstract[i] = snb$abstract[which(snb$title2 == end$title2[i])]
  }else if(end$dtset[i] == "supl"){
    end$title[i] = supl$biblio_title[which(supl$title2 == end$title2[i])]
    end$year[i] = supl$biblio_year[which(supl$title2 == end$title2[i])]
    end$authors[i] = supl$biblio_authors[which(supl$title2 == end$title2[i])]
    end$journal[i] = supl$biblio_container[which(supl$title2 == end$title2[i])]
    end$doi[i] = supl$biblio_permanent_id[which(supl$title2 == end$title2[i])]
    end$abstract[i] = supl$biblio_abstract[which(supl$title2 == end$title2[i])]
  }
}

torescreen = end %>% filter(is.na(notes))

# write_refs(torescreen, format = "bib", file = "../screening/Rescreen.bib")
write.csv(torescreen, "../screening/Rscreen.csv", row.names = F)
write.csv(end, "../screening/fulldata.csv", row.names = F)
```
